attributes.board_name: Nebraska Board of Occupational Therapy Practice (DHHS Licensure Unit)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Content must relate to OT (research, treatment, documentation, education or management). State/national association meetings, workshops, seminars, webinars, conferences, monitored video and in-service (hour for hour); college courses (1 semester hour = 15, 1 quarter hour = 10 contact hours); formal self-study with a test; management courses max 10; Level II fieldwork supervision 1 per student, max 2; publications 4 each, max 10; informal self-study max 2; specialty certification exam 20; presentations max 4. Not accepted: medical terminology, on-the-job training, orientation, CPR.
rules.audit_note: Renewal under Neb. Rev. Stat. §38-2521 and 172 NAC 10; keep documentation listed for each activity type.
rules.notes: All OT and OTA licenses expire August 1 of each even-numbered year; hours must be earned in the preceding 24 months. 1 hour = at least 60 minutes. Text checked is the 2020 edition of 172 NAC 114; a revision proposal is on file with the Secretary of State.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same activity types as OTs; management courses max 7.5 hours per 24-month period.
